frontiers.title: The proposed Webb line toward England
frontiers.summary: The father-name is strongly supported in compiled tradition, but the Elizabeth Douglas identity is conflicting and the parent couple lacks decisive locality-wide proof.

candidatePaths.warning: Candidate parents, not established ancestors; Elizabeth Douglas may combine two different women.
Compiled New England chain requiring original parish, land, probate and kinship evidence.
Proposed English extension; identity and migration chain remain unresolved.

frontiers.nextProof: Reconcile East Hampton and Chatham church, land, probate, household and sibling-cluster evidence before evaluating the deeper New England and English chain.

frontiers.title: The Gooley, Goulet and possible French connection
frontiers.summary: John Peter Gooley's Canadian birth is strongly supported, but his reported father Peter or Pierre has not been identified securely.

candidatePaths.warning: Reported parent and origin question; Irish, Anglophone and French-Canadian possibilities remain open.
The 1846 Pierre Goulet–Louise-Anne Tellier marriage is authentic, but no record yet identifies that Pierre as John Peter Gooley's father.

frontiers.nextProof: Find John Peter Gooley's baptism or another direct record naming his parents before connecting the documented candidate Goulet family or extending the line toward France.
